_note: Board 302:2026 — the same chassis, Advanced tab active.
NOT CONFORMED, and this tab diverges most:
· The board's three fields are 'Custom <head> code', 'Password protect'
and 'Canonical URL'. The shipped tab is a Visibility segmented control,
a password field shown only at visibility=password, two indexing
toggles and the head-code textarea. There is no canonical-URL field at
all and no 'Password protect' switch (the password field IS the
control). Joining those by position would measure unrelated rows.
· The section headings ('VISIBILITY', 'CUSTOM <HEAD> CODE') ship as 11/600
ink uppercase; the board draws them as ordinary 13/ink-muted field
labels (2838:12129). That is a structural claim — heading vs label —
rather than a property one, and it is the same two-class question the
Settings pane already answers the other way (uppercase 11px card
titles, S7 shared.tsx). Left for the family, not settled from one tab.
· seg/will-publish (2838:12130) proposes a FOURTH visibility state for an
unset value, with the line 'Will publish — this page ships with the next
deploy. Nothing is stored until you choose otherwise.' Commit 9fd45cde2
settled the same question the other way five days ago: unset visibility
IS live, because PageManager never writes the field and treating unset
as draft would drop every non-home page from every existing site's next
deploy. Adopting the board's fourth segment means a schema change and a
migration, not a re-label. Reported to the founder, not built.
· TextInput border-color — authority=open:input-fill, see the SEO recipe.
